idea_name: Tick-gap greater than 60s as auction proxy
mechanism: In replay LoopEventOnTime, each ~1 s server-time bump checks (m_Ticks.Info[m_ReplayCount].time - m_Ticks.Info[m_ReplayCount-1].time) > 60; if true, writes ULONG_MAX into the RePlay Time GlobalVariable so GetBarTime returns ULONG_MAX and Update shows Auction. Live path still uses TimeCurrent; missing GlobalVariable also maps to auction. Complements the Part-29 book-type auction sensor for replay gaps and thin liquidity.
